summary_zh.motivation: 设计并制造轻质点阵结构，探索其力学性能。
summary_zh.method: 使用选择性激光熔化制备多种点阵结构并进行压缩测试。
summary_zh.result: 获得了不同点阵结构的力学性能数据，验证了设计可行性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验压缩测试验证力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To design and fabricate lightweight lattice structures and investigate their mechanical properties for potential engineering applications.
summary_en.method: Various lattice unit cells were manufactured via selective laser melting and subjected to quasi-static compression testing.
summary_en.result: The mechanical properties, including stiffness and strength, were characterized for different lattice topologies.
summary_en.validation: Experimental compression tests provided validation of the finite element predictions and design approach.

papers.title: Residual Stresses of AlSi10Mg Fabricated by Selective Laser Melting (SLM)
papers.abstract: The aim of the paper is the residual stress analysis of AlSi10Mg material fabricated by selective laser melting (SLM). The SLM technique allows to product of complex geometries based on three-dimensional model, in which stiffness and porosity can be precisely designed for specific uses. As the studied material, there were chosen solid samples built in two different directions: parallel (P-L) and perpendicular (P-R) to the tested surface and cellular lattice built in perpendicular direction, as well. In the paper, for the complex characterization of obtained materials, the phase analysis, residual stress and texture studies were performed. The classical non-destructive sin2ψ method was used to measure the residual stress measurements. The final products, both solid sample and cellular lattice, have a homogeneous phase composition and consist of solid solution Al(Si) (Fm-3m) type, Si (Fd-3m) and Mg2Si (Pnma). The obtained values of the crystallite size are in a range of 1000 Å for Al(Si), 130-180 Å for Si phase. For Mg2Si phase, the crystallite sizes depend on sintering process, they are 800 Å for solid samples and 107 Å for cellular lattice. The residual stress results have the compressive character and they are in a range from –5 to –15 MPa.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究AlSi10Mg的选区激光熔化残余应力，未涉及生物医用植入物设计或力学性能评估。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implant materials (e.g., Ti alloys), stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration; it focuses on residual stress characterization of a non-biomedical alloy (AlSi10Mg).

summary_zh.motivation: 分析选区激光熔化AlSi10Mg材料的残余应力分布
summary_zh.method: 采用sin2ψ法对平行和垂直方向试样及多孔结构进行XRD残余应力测量
summary_zh.result: 所有试样呈压应力状态，应力范围-5至-15 MPa，晶粒尺寸随结构变化
summary_zh.validation: 通过X射线衍射实验验证残余应力测量结果

summary_en.motivation: To characterize residual stresses in AlSi10Mg fabricated by selective laser melting for different build orientations and lattice structures.
summary_en.method: Residual stresses were measured using the classical sin2ψ X-ray diffraction method on solid samples built parallel and perpendicular to the tested surface and on a cellular lattice built perpendicularly.
summary_en.result: All samples exhibited compressive residual stresses ranging from -5 to -15 MPa, with crystallite sizes varying by structure (e.g., 800 Å for solid vs. 107 Å for lattice in Mg2Si).
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation was performed via non-destructive XRD residual stress measurements on multiple sample types.

papers.title: Effect of post-treatments on microstructure and mechanical properties of a novel nickel-based powder metallurgy superalloy processed by selective laser melting
papers.abstract: A newly developed third generation nickel-based powder metallurgy (PM) superalloy, designated as FGH100L, was produced through Selective Laser Melting (SLM). Post-treatments, including Heat Treatment (HT), Hot Isostatic Pressing (HIP) and combined HIP + HT treatment, were carried out on the as-SLMed alloy to improve its mechanical properties by controlling the microstructure and/or reducing the defects in the alloy. Both HT and HIP treatments facilitated the recovery and recrystallization of the superalloy, especially when the solution temperature reached 1150 °C, thereby homogenizing the microstructure and refining the grains. During the post-treatment, the number density of γ' precipitates increased obviously with the process varying from SLM, SLM + HIP, SLM + HT to SLM + HIP + HT, and both yield strength and ultimate strength increased accordingly, indicating that the precipitation strengthening played a major role in improving the alloy strength. During the HIP process, the size and quantity of the pores were greatly reduced, which contributed greatly to a much higher elongation of the SLM + HIP alloy than that of the SLM and SLM + HT alloys. The fracture surfaces of the SLM alloys after different post-treatments showed transgranular fracture features, while the intergranular fracture was the main fracture mode of the as-SLM alloy.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究后处理对SLM成形镍基高温合金力学性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 采用SLM制备FGH100L合金，并进行HT、HIP及HIP+HT处理
summary_zh.result: HIP+HT处理显著提高强度，HIP减少孔隙改善延伸率
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸测试和显微组织表征验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of post-treatments on the microstructure and mechanical properties of a nickel-based superalloy fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: FGH100L superalloy was processed by SLM and subjected to heat treatment (HT), hot isostatic pressing (HIP), and combined HIP+HT, with microstructural characterization and tensile testing.
summary_en.result: HIP+HT treatment enhanced yield and ultimate strength due to increased γ' precipitates, while HIP alone improved elongation by reducing porosity.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical properties were validated through tensile tests and fracture surface analysis.

papers.title: Effect of Build Orientation on the Corrosion Behavior and Mechanical Properties of Selective Laser Melted Ti-6Al-4V
papers.abstract: Ti-6Al-4V alloys with different build orientations have been fabricated by selective laser melting (SLM). The corrosion behavior and mechanical properties have been studied. Investigation of microstructures were characterized by optical microscopy (OM), scanning electron microscopy (SEM), and X-ray diffraction (XRD) analysis. Electrochemical results show that the vertical sample and horizontal sample possess excellent corrosion resistance in the cross section and longitudinal section respectively, which can be attributed to the presence of less acicular α′ martensite and more β phase. Mechanical properties of all samples were determined by compression testing and hardness measurements. The compression strength (σc) and plastic deformation (εp) of the horizontal sample were higher than those of the vertical sample and the sample with building direction of 45°, because the molten pool boundaries (MPBs) play a significant role in the microscopic slipping at the loading SLM parts. In addition, the sample with building orientation of 45° achieved highest hardness. Therefore, distinct anisotropy due to different build orientations.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了SLM Ti-6Al-4V各向异性对腐蚀和力学性能的影响，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳等生物医学关键问题。
llm.why_not_core: No porous structure, no stress shielding evaluation, no fatigue testing, and no osseointegration or surface roughness characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM制备Ti-6Al-4V时构建方向对腐蚀和力学性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 通过XRD、SEM、电化学测试和压缩试验分析不同取向的微观结构和性能
summary_zh.result: 垂直和水平样品分别在横截面和纵截面表现出优异耐蚀性，水平样品压缩强度更高
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测试（压缩、硬度、电化学）验证各向异性行为

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of build orientation on the corrosion behavior and mechanical properties of selective laser melted Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.method: Microstructural characterization (OM, SEM, XRD) combined with electrochemical tests and compression/hardness measurements across three build orientations.
summary_en.result: Vertical and horizontal samples exhibit superior corrosion resistance in cross and longitudinal sections respectively; horizontal samples achieve higher compressive strength due to molten pool boundary effects.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation through corrosion testing (electrochemical) and mechanical testing (compression, hardness).
